subject: re-st
title: (R)RE.DEF.------IST.F.
description: Chart on book p. 307 (WI-23). RE-ST (restructuralism) is the subject (the arrow points to RE-ST; the title begins with (R)RE.DEF.); IST-F (isolated focus) is the partner. The line from the subject runs down to the CRTF-PROG line and on to the line from RE-DEF to IST-F. From the subject: TR-DEF (trans-definition), CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism), RE-DEF (redefinitions), EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From CRTF-PROG: TRS (transition). From EXP-DY: AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree). From T-C-IMP: STF (source transfer). From AFI-2: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics). From STF: ACC-F (accelerated functionalism). From ACC-F: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). RE-DEF has the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
